about: The engine's calibration corrections — the same cases in every edition. The engine holds the active calibration (the file 'calibrationFile') and computes its per-bin dB corrections from its own bins: bin i is at i × sampleRate / fftSize Hz, its exact frequency. Each case: the engine at 'sampleRate' (after 'fromSampleRate', when given — the corrections must follow a rate change), with the calibration applied; 'bins' are bin indices and 'expect' the correction at each, within 'tolerance' dB. Expected values are the calibration file interpolated at the exact bin frequency; a correction taken at the whole hertz below (the fault this guards) is 1.06 dB away at bin 15.

cases.note: the corrections are the calibration at each bin's exact frequency (10.99, 11.72, 12.45, 88.62, 1000.49 and 15000 Hz)
after the sample rate changes from 48 kHz to 44.1 kHz, the corrections follow the new bins
